policy: Item-price-only rolling averages. Exact variant; latest dated ask per listing and one comparable per seller. Shipping/tax/checkout totals excluded. Verified sales first, current asks (30 days) then historical asks (180 days), minimum three independent sellers; reviewed MSRP +10%/year fallback retained by owner on 2026-10-19. 1.5-IQR screening at 5+ observations.
